Hi Jordan — thanks for the timing. Quick answers and an operational plan from our side.

- Logs in-scope: We will include API request logs (request id, timestamp, endpoint, response codes), authentication/access logs (user id, source IP, success/failure), and key rotation/audit events. We will NOT include raw customer data payloads — only metadata and system audit events. I will prepare a one-page log scope doc for your auditor.

- Transfer method: Redwood can accept an encrypted bundle via SFTP (preferred) or provide a secure, time-limited Drive export. For SFTP we will provide upload credentials and an ingestion checklist.

- Timeline proposal:
  * By 2028-03-05: Redwood places initial evidence manifest and test artifacts in Drive (read-only).
  * By 2028-03-18: Redwood prepares full export bundle and notifies ACME; temporary retention bump (90 days) goes into effect 2028-03-19.
  * Auditor requests week of 2028-03-20.

- Seat uplift: We can provision a +20% concurrency uplift starting 2028-12-01 for the quarter; billing will be pro-rated and captured in the contract amendment. Laura will attach pricing.

I'll attach the log-scope stub and SFTP checklist in the next message.

Best,
Monica Patel
